title: Jio has this huge IPO and still Google and Meta are not selling a single share. What do they see that we do not?
author: Electronic_Tea_2948
selftext:
This one is bugging me. Google and Meta have been in Jio since 2020 and are sitting on nearly 1 lakh crore in paper gains. This listing was the perfect chance to book some of it. Yet neither is selling even one share.

If I had doubled my money I would take at least some off the table. These are two of the smartest companies out there and they are holding everything.

So what do they know that we do not? Is Jio that good a long term bet, or am I missing something?
